title: Homer City power plant redevelopment and data center planning records
method: Read each public record for the actor, date, scope and status of the decision. Use the DOE letter's reported values for historical and proposed generating capacity and acreage. Use the state letter for the disposal permit boundary and the county notice for land development review status. The records describe different boundaries. The sample does not calculate net developable acreage or available load.
